messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — the legacy trace collector drifted its sampling/window alignment and we lost ~40% of spans for services behind the old enricher. I want to propose a short remediation sweep and owners so we don't keep seeing recurring drop patterns.

samir: Ugh. Do we have the exact time window and config change that caused it?

elaine: The drift started ~2026-03-18T02:10Z when the collector's rollover timer moved from 60s -> 60000ms in a bad deploy (config read as ms not s). Root cause: unit mismatch in env var parsing. Affected window: ~02:10–07:30 UTC.

michael: I can own the backfill for the 48h window. Estimated runtime ~6h on prod backfill infra. Will open a task. JIRA: OBS-4821.

anya: I'll take dashboarding/alerts — add a metric for "span_ingest_window_seconds" and an alert when >120s or drops >10% spans/min.

kevin: Is aggregation correctness affected too or just drop? We saw some odd rollup counts yesterday.

elaine: Aggregation drift happened because late batches were bucketed into previous windows by the old enricher; that combined with missed spans produced underestimated counts. Patch PR open: https://github.com/redwood/collector/pull/789 (fixes parsing + defensive defaults).

samir: Nice. Can we also add a canary for config parsing? Maybe a startup self-check that validates units.

michael: I'll include a migration plan in the backfill ticket: dry run against staging, then prod in batches. ETA for dry run: Thu EOD.

anya: I'll add the dashboard panels and a synthetic that emits a span every 30s to validate the pipeline end-to-end.

elaine: Action items (owners + deadlines):
- michael: full backfill plan + dry run (JIRA OBS-4821) — dry run Thu EOD, prod backfill Fri EOD.
- anya: dashboard + synthetic check + alert rule (PR to dashboards repo) — Fri AM.
- samir: add config-parsing self-check and unit tests + prod rollout plan — Wed EOD.
- kevin: audit aggregator windowing logic for late batches and add a regression test — Thu EOD.
- engineering-oncall: monitor alert "span_ingest_window_seconds" during rollout; escalate if recurrence.

kevin: Can we add owners in the postmortem doc too and mark who is the escalation? I can be secondary after michael.

elaine: Yep, I'll update the postmortem and tag owners. Also setting a follow-up sync next Tue 11:00 UTC to confirm closure.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync in 6 days (Tue 11:00 UTC).

samir: One more ask — please add a small regression test that replays a few late batches with timestamp skew to ensure aggregator bucketing stays stable. I'll draft it.

michael: Backfill note: we'll snapshot current aggregates before replay to allow quick rollback if counts diverge.

anya: I'll add an Ops runbook snippet for future incidents: detection thresholds, who to page, quick mitigation (pin old collector, restart enricher, toggle sampling).

elaine: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem with these action items and the timelines. If anyone can't meet their ETA, @here call it out in this thread so we can reassign. :thumbsup:

samir: :thumbsup:

kevin: LGTM

michael: Filed OBS-4821 and linked PRs, assigning myself. https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/OBS-4821

elaine: Closing loop: I updated the postmortem doc and added owners + PR links. Will re-check after the backfill completes and mark postmortem resolved.
